enchant_guidance.label: Should Restoration Druid Healers Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: Restoration Druids favor choosing Aldor. The shoulder enchant  from the Aldor is better than the Scryer alternative . There aren't any notable BoP items from either vendor. Since many Restoration Druids tend to have tailoring, the Aldors also offer the ability to make your own  with the BoP recipe .
